title: Skater and Critic
body:
We have skate\_record, a DataFrame where each row describes a skating performance with the following columns:
- critic\_1: Critic 1's rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)
- critic\_2: Critic 2's rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)
- comment: An audience comment on that performance. (type $$=$$ str)
- self\_rating: The skate`r's self-rating on the performance. (type $$=$$ numpy.int64)

All ratings are between $$0$$ to $$100$$ inclusive. A sample of $$skate_{record}$$ is shown below:
$$critic_1$$ | $$critic_2$$ | comment | $$self_{rating}$$
$$88$$ | $$88$$ | That SHOWDOWN in Shinjuku arena was awesome | $$90$$
$$90$$ | $$85$$ | The rotational speed of the skater WAS very fast | $$84$$
$$70$$ | $$84$$ | I think the performance was a bit too slow | $$75$$
$$90$$ | $$85$$ | The skater'`s footwork was, just, WOW! | $$94$$
$$83$$ | $$89$$ | The skater OWNED the competition! | $$90$$
